items.label: Project authorization
acceptance_criteria: Project code, sponsor, phase, currency and authorization reference are approved.
The project exists before Activity Sheet, WBS Sheet, Cost Sheet or Funding Sheet operations.

items.label: Funding authority
acceptance_criteria: Funding source, authorization, restrictions, currency and availability are recorded.
Funding is traceable to WBS, control account, CBS, commitment and forecast.

items.label: Operational setup
acceptance_criteria: Project number, template, attribute form, permissions and modules are configured.
Cost Sheet, Funding Sheet and P6 mapping are ready before Get Data.

items.label: Role matrix and approvals
items.next_action: Load client role matrix and BP approval policies
acceptance_criteria: Client role matrix is configured for Planning, Controls, Cost/Funding, AWP, Contracts and Document Control.
BP actions have required role and permission policies before production approval.

items.label: Integrated baseline approval
items.next_action: Confirm cost loading, currency and mappings before approval
acceptance_criteria: All schedule activities are mapped before baseline approval.
Cost loading and currency confirmation are complete before approving the baseline.

items.label: System Activity Sheet
items.next_action: Run Get Data with XML/XER schedule
acceptance_criteria: Activity Sheet is created from the controlled P6 XML/XER source.
Activities include WBS, dates, data date, costs, resource assignments and stable activity IDs.

items.label: WBS Sheet roll-up
items.next_action: Load Activity Sheet to generate WBS roll-up
acceptance_criteria: WBS Sheet reflects hierarchy, activity count, planned cost and planned value.
WBS does not replace CBS; it remains the approved scope structure.

items.label: Schedule quality gate
items.evidence: Quality score 94.0; 3 control activities, 2 FS relationships, data date verified, all activities mapped to control accounts.
acceptance_criteria: Schedule quality gate checks open starts/finishes, leads/lags, missing dates and cost loading.
Rejected or low-quality schedules do not become the control baseline.

items.label: FBS / Funding codes
acceptance_criteria: Each fund has source, type, authorization, restrictions, approved amount, currency and status.
Funds can be assigned to control accounts, commitments, costs and forecast.

items.label: CBS and cost codes
items.evidence: 0 CBS code(s); 0 integrated cost code(s); 3 mapping(s).
acceptance_criteria: CBS classifies cost nature and does not replace WBS or FBS.
Cost codes connect WBS, control account, CBS, FBS, contract and package evidence.

items.label: BP governance
items.next_action: Configure BP policies and create CBS/FBS/WBS transactions
acceptance_criteria: BP CBS+Fund and BP CBS+WBS enforce funding availability and approval policies.
Line items maintain version history for edits, approvals and audit.

items.label: BIM quantity takeoff
items.next_action: Review unmapped BIM/IFC or Excel quantity lines before package release
acceptance_criteria: Controlled physical quantity items are consolidated from BIM/IFC or Excel before package release.
Each quantity line keeps element GUID, IFC class, spatial/system context, unit, quantity and WBS/CBS/FBS/package mapping.
Unmapped quantity lines stay in review before CWP/IWP release.

items.label: AWP package chain
acceptance_criteria: Packages are tied to WBS, control account, path of construction and responsible owner.
IWP release depends on critical constraints and funding readiness when applicable.

items.label: Constraint management
items.next_action: Capture, assign and close package constraints
acceptance_criteria: Restrictions have owner, required date, priority, evidence and closure note.
Blocked packages cannot be treated as ready for release.

items.label: Evidence and closeout
acceptance_criteria: Evidence supports approvals, changes, constraints, claims, payment and closeout.
Closeout retains audit trail by project, WBS, control account, package and funding source.
